text: 上周五美股收跌，两年期美债收益率升逾10基点，黄金重挫3%。美伊周末互袭，国际原油周一亚市盘初涨超2%。 美官员称周日美军打击伊朗拉腊克岛两处武器装置、指伊方试图在海峡布雷；伊朗军方称向美军基地发射导弹。 美联储主席沃什杰克逊霍尔首秀放鹰，为2009年来最鹰杰克逊霍尔讲话，暗示通胀不快速回落将加息。市场预测9月加息概率从35%升至近六成、2027年3月前或加息两次。 美国非农就业人数初步下修7.9万，与市场预期的上修18.3万人相反，就业降温延续。 杰克逊霍尔期间，欧央行官员警告通胀、倾向9月加息，英央行行长暗示不急行动。 报道称美国卖欧元买日元提前未打
text_en: U.S. stocks fell last Friday, the 2-year Treasury yield rose more than 10 basis points, and gold slumped 3%. Over the weekend, the U.S. and Iran traded strikes, and international crude oil rose over 2% in early Asian trading Monday. U.S. officials said Sunday U.S. forces struck two weapons sites on Iran's Larak Island and accused Iran of trying to lay mines in the Strait; Iran's military said it fired missiles at a U.S. base. Fed Chair Warsh delivered a hawkish Jackson Hole debut, the most hawkish Jackson Hole speech since 2009, hinting at rate hikes if inflation does not fall quickly. Market odds for a September hike rose from 35% to nearly 60%, with possibly two hikes before March 2027. U.S. nonfarm payrolls were preliminarily revised down by 79,000, opposite to market expectations of an upward revision of 183,000, as the labor market cooling continues.
